title: Crashes on startup after 3.2.1 update
body: App crashes immediately after opening. Tried reinstalling but same issue persists. iPhone 14 Pro, iOS 17.2. Was working fine before the update.
author: frustrated_user_42

title: Keeps crashing when opening projects
body: Was working fine until the latest update. Now it crashes every time I try to open my projects. Lost hours of work. Please fix this ASAP.
author: designer_pro

title: Broken after update - lost all data
body: The new update broke everything. Can't open any of my saved work. Very frustrated. This is unacceptable for a paid app.
author: angry_customer

title: Good app but too many bugs
body: I love the concept and the AI features are great, but there are too many bugs. Export feature doesn't work half the time. The app freezes when working with large files.
author: tech_reviewer

title: Best productivity app ever
body: This app changed my workflow completely. The AI features are amazing and save me hours every week. The collaboration tools are top-notch. Highly recommended!
author: happy_user

title: Great but needs dark mode
body: Really useful app with clean UI. Would be perfect with dark mode support for night usage. Also wish there were more export options.
author: night_owl

title: Export to PDF produces blank pages
body: PDF export produces blank pages. This is a critical feature for my work. I need to share reports with clients and this bug is costing me business. Please fix.
author: business_user

title: Slow performance with large files
body: App becomes very slow when working with large files. Needs performance optimization. Sometimes takes 30+ seconds to load a project. Otherwise good features.
author: power_user_99

title: Excellent collaboration tool
body: The collaboration features are top-notch. My team uses it every day for project management. Real-time editing works flawlessly. Best app in its category.
author: team_lead

title: Lost all my data after update
body: After the update all my projects disappeared. This is unacceptable. I need my data back immediately. Weeks of work gone. Filing a complaint.
author: devastated_user

title: Love the new AI features
body: The AI-powered suggestions are really helpful. The app learns from my usage patterns and offers relevant recommendations. Would love to see more customization options.
author: ai_enthusiast

title: Too expensive now
body: The new pricing is ridiculous. $20/month for features that used to be free. Considering switching to a competitor. Not worth the money anymore.
author: budget_conscious

title: Perfect for team collaboration
body: Our team of 20 people uses this daily. The real-time sync and version history are game-changers. Customer support is also very responsive.
author: manager_mike

title: Decent app, needs UI improvements
body: The app is functional but the UI feels outdated. Navigation is confusing for new users. The settings menu is buried too deep. Hope they redesign it soon.
author: ux_critic

title: Login broken after update
body: Can't login anymore after the latest update. It says 'authentication failed' even though my password is correct. Tried resetting password but the reset email never arrives.
author: locked_out_user
